task_instance: Given a user's exact NVSHMEM launch command plus complete per-PE INFO-level logs for a 2-PE/1-node run that fails with 'No more teams available' during nvshmem_team_split_strided, diagnose the failure conservatively and produce both a structured diagnosis and a paste-ready GitHub bug report following the bundled template.
evidence: Created sample input the user would supply under input/: launch_command.txt (direct nvshmrun -n 2 launch with the three NVSHMEM_DEBUG settings) and two per-PE INFO logs plus combined stdout. Ran the skill's read-only workflow with rg/head/sed: confirmed the INFO-logging gate (10 and 11 NVSHMEM INFO records per PE), identified the identical first causal line on both PEs ('No more teams available, increase NVSHMEM_MAX_TEAMS') separate from the PE 1 cascade abort, and extracted the evidence record (version 3.5.6+cuda12.8, PMI bootstrap, P2P/NVLink transport, NVSHMEM_MAX_TEAMS=32, failure during team creation at iteration 27). Matched it against the bundled knowledge base section 'NVSHMEM_MAX_TEAMS Exhaustion' (signatures matched exactly) and classified it Class 1 confirmed bundled match. Produced two deliverables: diagnosis.md with the five required headings (Evidence Collected, Diagnosis, Knowledge-Base Match, Version Applicability, Next Actions), separating observation/documentation/inference/verification; and bug_report.md mirroring the GitHub issue form. Verified bug_report.md programmatically: title starts with the required Issue prefix, all six required H2 headings present, exactly one impact value selected (Application crash), first causal error preserved verbatim, and 6 'Not provided' gap markers for missing facts. Version-specific numbers (default/internal-team counts) were labeled UNVERIFIED because the skill's live-doc verification path is unavailable in this environment (no nvshmem-docs skill registered and web tools disallowed by the run rules); the skill explicitly permits labeling such claims unverified, so the core read-only deliverable is complete. Files: diagnosis.md, bug_report.md, input/.
